correctness.rationale: For projection of Gr(d,E⊕F) from [∧^d F], a one-swap affine source chart has coordinates a_j,b_i,z_ij,c, with only c (the all-F Plücker coordinate) discarded. All retained maximal minors generate precisely C[a,b,z,c z]: each c term outside the discarded minor contains some z; the retained minors recover each a,b,z and c z. The rank-one relations among (z,c z) give an exact scheme-theoretic chart A^{2d−2}×D_k, k=(d−1)^2. Its vertex locus is the Segre Z_d, with Hilbert numerator 1+(k−1)t, multiplicity k. Outside the projected tangent-direction space, Plücker quadrics solve for the omitted coordinate, proving smoothness elsewhere and global normality. Independently checked every retained minor d=3 and d=4 by exact determinants; the general determinant and inverse arguments prove all d≥3, d=2 is smooth.
